# RESULTS PACK

All numbers are copied from existing files in `results/`, `results/optimization/` and `diagnostics/` (CSV text copied verbatim; JSON floats printed with Python's shortest round-trip repr, i.e. the same digits as in the file). Nothing was re-run. `NOT FOUND` = not present in the files; `n/a` = not defined (explained in the note). Test-set values come from `results/metrics_<id>.json` and `results/optimization/optimization_metrics.csv`; benchmark values from the Docker runs (`--cpus=1 --memory=1g`).

| abstract value | value in the files | verdict |
